raw_record.question_text:

When appreciating the "Ashima Landscape" in the figure, what aesthetic method still needs to be used?

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a stone-forest/rock pillar landscape labeled “阿诗玛景观.” Then read the accompanying text list: 1 俯视, 2 选择特定位置, 3 把握观赏时机, 4 抓住景观特色, 5 发挥想象, 6 领悟自然与人文的和谐之美. The question asks specifically what aesthetic way is also needed, so match “审美方式” to item 5 and answer: 发挥想象。

method.method_draft: First describe the visual scene: the rock pillars resemble a figure only when viewed and interpreted as “阿诗玛,” a legendary Yi girl. Since the image itself is not literally a person but a natural stone form, the viewer must mentally connect the rock outline with the legend and human image.
